title: Assemble a Rubin/BRR-Fay Fixed-Effect Target — pv_brr_target
text: plausible value \(m\), design-based within-covariance replicate sandwich $$\hat U_m = a_d \sum_{r=1}^{R}   (\hat\beta_m^{(r)} - \hat\beta_m)(\hat\beta_m^{(r)} - \hat\beta_m)^\top,   \qquad a_d = \frac{1}{R\,(1 - k)^2},$$ \(\hat\beta_m\) full-sample weighted fixed-effect estimate, \(\hat\beta_m^{(r)}\) estimate replicate weight \(r\), \(R\) replicate count, \(k\) Fay coefficient (fay_k). multiplier \(a_d\) returned fay_variance_multiplier.

title: Assemble a Rubin/BRR-Fay Fixed-Effect Target — pv_brr_target
text: per-plausible-value estimates covariances combined Rubin mean \(\bar\beta\), within-imputation covariance \(\bar U\), -imputation covariance \(B\), $$\bar\beta = \frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^{M}\hat\beta_m, \qquad   \bar U = \frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^{M}\hat U_m, \qquad   B = \frac{1}{M-1}\sum_{m=1}^{M}   (\hat\beta_m - \bar\beta)(\hat\beta_m - \bar\beta)^\top,$$ giving Rubin total covariance — external target — $$T_{\mathrm{MI}} = \bar U + \left(1 + \tfrac{1}{M}\right) B.$$ Standard errors \(\sqrt{\mathrm{diag}(T_{\mathrm{MI}})}\). fraction missing information \(\gamma_k = (1 + 1/M)\,B_{kk}/T_{\mathrm{MI},kk}\) related Rubin quantities returned fmi, riv, lambda.
